newsitem.title: GERMANY: ATHLETICS-GERMAN HIGH JUMPERS HIT BY INJURIES.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GERMAN HIGH JUMPERS HIT BY INJURIES.

text.p: Germany's chances of retaining their men's and women's European Cup titles in Munich this weekend have been hit by the withdrawal through injury of both their first-choice high jumpers.
Alina Astafei, winner of the European Cup competition in 1995 and 1996, has withdraw from the women's event for which she was favourite.
Astafei, suffering from a foot injury, will be replaced by Heike Balck, who last competed in the European Cup in 1989 when she jumped for the former German Democratic Republic.
Wolfgang Kreissig has had to withdraw from the men's event with a back injury and the inexperienced Martin Buss will take his place.
